data.calibrationVersionNote: unchanged. A status change does not move a calibration version.
data.formalStateMeaning: Historical Holdout V6 returned FAIL. The synthetic set is correctly never opened.

stateVocabulary.CANDIDATE2_FORMAL_VALIDATION_NOT_STARTED: no formal stage has produced a result
stateVocabulary.CANDIDATE2_HISTORICAL_V6_FAILED: Historical Holdout V6 returned FAIL. The synthetic set is correctly never opened.
stateVocabulary.CANDIDATE2_HISTORICAL_V6_INVALID: Historical Holdout V6 could not produce a formal result. The synthetic set is correctly never opened.
stateVocabulary.CANDIDATE2_STAGE1_PASSED_STAGE2_PENDING: Historical Holdout V6 passed; the synthetic set has not yet been opened
stateVocabulary.CANDIDATE2_SYNTHETIC_FAILED: Historical Holdout V6 passed and the synthetic set returned FAIL
stateVocabulary.CANDIDATE2_SYNTHETIC_INVALID: Historical Holdout V6 passed and the synthetic set could not produce a formal result
stateVocabulary.CANDIDATE2_FORMAL_VALIDATION_PASSED: both formal stages returned PASS on the same locked candidate

data.holdoutValidatedRule: calibrationStatus and formalValidationStatus become HOLDOUT_VALIDATED only under CANDIDATE2_FORMAL_VALIDATION_PASSED. Under every other state the calibration status is exactly what the lock recorded.

stages.notOpenedBecause: Historical Holdout V6 returned HISTORICAL_HOLDOUT_V6_FAIL. A synthetic stress pass says nothing about a candidate that failed the historical stage, and opening it would consume a one-shot resource for no evidence.

data.previewNote: a preview package may not be prepared unless both formal stages pass
data.nextRequirement: Candidate 2 formal validation has failed. A Candidate 3 would require its own repair, its own lock and a NEW unseen historical holdout — V6 is consumed and may be used only as a failed-holdout diagnostic set. Synthetic Stress Holdout V2 remains sealed and unread and is still available to a future candidate.

legacy-holdout-v1.integrity: Never read. Any Phase 6C2 tuning result can be honestly validated against it.
legacy-holdout-v1.note: LEGACY_MIXED_HOLDOUT — preserved unchanged, not reused for formal historical validation.

historical-holdout-v2.integrity: Never read. A Phase 6C3 validation against it is genuinely independent.
historical-holdout-v2.note: INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE_ARCHIVE — genuinely unread, but three fixtures cannot validate generalisation. Superseded by v3 and archived rather than consumed.

synthetic-stress-v1.integrity: Never read. A Phase 6C3 validation against it is genuinely independent.
synthetic-stress-v1.note: Its counter reads 0 because the seal was created after the simulations. Not a holdout.

historical-holdout-v3.integrity: Read 1 time(s). Check the access log before treating a result as independent.
